Core Active Vocabulary (10 items):

red — the colour of blood. Example: She is wearing a red jacket.
green — the colour of grass. Example: My phone is green.
black — the colour of night. Example: He has got black hair.
white — the colour of snow. Example: He is wearing a white shirt.
circle — a round shape. Example: There is a red circle on the wall.
square — a shape with four equal sides. Example: It is a small black square.
long — measuring a lot from end to end. Example: She has got long hair.
short — of less than average height, or not long. Example: She is short with dark hair.
big — large in size. Example: It is a big red bag.
small — little in size. Example: It is a small square box.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• It is a big red bag.
• What colour is it?
• It is black.
• It is a small square.
• It is long and thin.

a BIG RED bag
Listen and repeat three times.
Which word carries the main stress?
Grammar focus: Adjective order.
Put size before colour before the noun: a big red bag. Put shape before colour: a small square box.
Controlled practice: choose the correct option.
Choose the correct order.

Reading: read the text and answer the questions.

Listening: listen to the dialogue and answer the questions.
A: What does it look like? B: It is a small black square. A: And the other one? B: It is a big red circle.
